description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3040013196011 CONNECTING LINK,RIG: Line 0001 Qty 20 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0083 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
